info.title: Catch Me Backend API
info.description:
# Catch Me API Specification
Comprehensive OpenAPI 3.0 documentation for the **Catch Me Backend** service. 
This API powers the Catch Me sports social and matchmaking ecosystem, handling user management, live match tracking, feed scoring and recommendations, engagement signals, leaderboards, global search, and AI-powered match summaries (via Google Gemini and xAI Grok).

get.description: Returns service identifier string to verify that the server is online.
Lightweight probe for load balancer health checking.
Retrieves all user profiles stored in Firestore.
Fast in-memory fuzzy search across minified local user data (`users_min.json`) via Fuse.js matching against `name` and `username`.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Query string matching name or username

get.description: Performs a prefix query directly against the `name` property in the Firestore `users` collection.
Retrieves complete user profile and preferences by Firestore document ID.

delete.description:
Deletes a user account and removes all associated traces across Firestore in an atomic batch:
- Removes ID from other users' `followers`, `following`, and `blockedUsers`.
- Removes ID from all posts' `likes`, `shares`, and `saves`.
- Deletes all posts authored by the user.
- Removes user from event player rosters (`data.players`) and polls (`data.votes.userVotes`).
- Deletes all chat documents where the user is a member.
- Deletes the primary user record.

200.description: User and all references successfully deleted

get.description: Traverses social graph (2nd-degree connections) to recommend users followed by the people the current user follows, ranked by mutual friend count.

Generates a comprehensive personalized feed for a user based on engagement weights, role multipliers, content quality thresholds, diversity controls, and affinity bonuses.
Feed results are automatically cached in the Firebase Realtime Database.
Retrieves a specific component of the feed for modular UI rendering or infinite scrolling.
Retrieves a filtered sub-component (e.g. `/api/feed/user123/posts/highlights` or `/api/feed/user123/popular/images`).
Retrieves all match events (`type == "game"`) from Firestore.
Retrieves a single match event by ID.

post.description: Re-computes and standardizes team stats and player stats according to the sport's scoring rules, updating Firestore.
Concludes a match by marking its status as `ended`.
Returns the URL used to stream/download the dynamic PDF game summary report.

get.description: Generates and streams a binary PDF game report containing team scores, stats tables, and game event timelines.

post.description: Generates an AI-written sports commentary summary using Google Gemini (with fallback to xAI Grok) and saves it in Firebase Realtime Database.

put.description: Regenerates AI game summary if the previous summary is older than 10 minutes (rate limited).

400.description: Throttle limit reached (last updated < 10 minutes ago)

message.example: Summary was updated recently. Please wait before updating again.

delete.description: Removes the game commentary summary from Firebase Realtime Database.

get.description: Retrieves all event records from Firestore.
Fast in-memory fuzzy search across minified local game and event data (`games_min.json`) via Fuse.js.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Search term matching event title, sport, or tag

get.description: Retrieves details of a specific event by Firestore Document ID.

delete.description: Deletes the event document and atomically removes its ID from users' `events`, `games`, `myCustomEvents`, `myGames`, `feed.events`, and `feed.games` arrays.

200.description: Event and its references deleted successfully

get.description: Retrieves events filtered by their `type` attribute (e.g. `game`, `practice`, `tournament`, `tryout`).

200.description: Array of events matching the type

get.description: Fast in-memory search across minified local post data (`posts_min.json`) via Fuse.js matching against `caption` and `tags`.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Search term matching post caption or hashtags

get.description: Generates user feed for the specified user ID.

delete.description:
Deletes a post and cleans up references across other collections:
- Removes post ID from `likedPosts` of all users who liked it.
- Removes post ID from `savedPosts` of all users who saved it.
- Removes post ID from creator's `posts` array.
- Deletes the primary post document.

post.description: Records user engagement signals such as viewing dwell time (in milliseconds) or user click interactions on posts or games.

get.description:
Returns paginated and ranked user leaderboards based on score calculation: `(level * 100) + xp + (followers * 5) + (posts * 2)`.
Results are cached daily per filter combination in Firebase Realtime Database.

post.description: Dispatches push notifications (or silent in-app events) via FCM and logs the dispatch in Firebase Realtime Database.
Resolves all active FCM device tokens for all registered users and executes a multicast push dispatch.

get.description: Executes unified search across individual user accounts, team accounts, and trending hashtags.

BearerAuth.description: Optional bearer token for authenticated user actions.

SessionIdHeader.name: x-session-id
SessionIdHeader.description: Client session identifier for A/B testing and algorithmic bucket routing (`A` or `B`).

PostIdPathParam.description: Target post's Firestore document ID (or User ID for post feed)

LimitQueryParam.description: Maximum number of items per page
